text:
elaine: Quick postmortem thread on the Optimize launch press cycle. A few items: errant stat correction, exec follow-ups, and traffic anomalies. Please drop confirmations in-thread.

mike: Noted. I handled the NYT correction earlier. They updated the line to the canonical 3x stat.

press-bot: Mention update logged: outlet=nyt status=corrected timestamp=1807008900

elaine: Thanks. CEO asked for a 1-paragraph internal summary for the exec comms email. Can someone draft a short blurb?

ceo: I'll take a stab 20 draft: "Great launch day. Optimize demonstrates predictable production gains and gives customers precise levers to tune cost vs latency. Big thanks to the team for the fast turn on partner outreach." Thoughts?

sophie: Clean. Maybe add a sentence about customer interest: "We've received requests from 12 customers for early access trials."

ceo: Added. Final draft posted to assets in /comms/exec/optimize-launch-blurb.txt

elaine: Nice. Analytics — we saw a spike in referral traffic from Partner X but an unexplained dip from organic search between 11:00-12:00 PT. @analytics can you confirm if there was a tracking redirect issue?

analytics: Investigating. Preliminary: one redirect rule expired in the CDN causing 302s instead of 301s for ~35 minutes. That likely impacted SEO crawler access but not paid channels. Full log in tracker.

mike: Fix deployed and redirects corrected at 11:37 PT. I pushed updated shortlinks where needed.

elaine: Great. Two action items: (1) ops postmortem note about redirect expiry (mike) (2) update partner playbook with reminder on shortlink expiry checks (elaine). Confirm when done.

mike: Ops note drafted and linked in the incident tracker.

press-bot: Patch: partner-bundle v1.1 reissued to partners with corrected links (sent=partner_contacts@redwood.com)

elaine: Final check: anyone seeing persistent misquotes or requests for re-briefs? If so escalate here and we'll coordinate follow-ups.

analytics: Closed for now. We'll share a short digest tomorrow with traffic + demo leads.

elaine: Thanks team. I'll compile this thread into the official postmortem doc and move to the marketing folder. :raised_hands:
